{{Top|leg}}
'''Endex''' was a codeword used by various military personnel throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to indicate the end of an exercise or mission. When repeated three times, it indicated the end of a battle or completion of a mission, and a signal to proceed with the wrap up of their assignment, as in returning to headquarters.
